quote:
The main finding of the original study, a correlation between ERN and EPS am-
plitude, did not reach the threshold for significance in our replication: r = -.25, p =
.11, one-tailed.
reason: The completed primary replication report by Lewis and Pitts (replicating Hajcak & Foti, 2008) explicitly reports the main Pearson product-moment correlation between ERN amplitude and error-potentiated startle (EPS) magnitude on p. 4 (Section 4.1-4.2) as r = -.25, matching the shipped value -0.25.
